prof.title: 👤 Profile
prof.zones.need: Heart-rate zones appear after a workout with a Garmin watch, or once your profile has a threshold or max HR.
prof.footer: The AI coach sees this data. Tap a field to change it.
prof.ask.max_hr: Max heart rate (bpm)? Best from a test or your hardest workout; 220 minus age is only a rough guess.
prof.ask.resting_hr: Resting heart rate (bpm), right after waking up?
prof.ask.injuries: Injuries and limitations to respect (e.g. "Achilles, no hill intervals")?
goal.title: 🎯 Goal
goal.none: 🎯 No goal: the bot is in ongoing-training mode — consistency, general fitness, health.
goal.name: 🎯 {name}
goal.deleted: Goal deleted, back to ongoing training.
goal.ask.target: Target time (h:mm:ss or mm:ss)? "-" for no time goal.
goal.ask.name: Race name (e.g. "Berlin Half")? "-" for none.
goal.saved: Goal saved. The AI coach will plan advice around it.
in.bad_date: Couldn't read the date. Format: DD.MM.YYYY.
in.date_past: The date must be in the future.
in.bad_time: Couldn't read the time. Example: 1:45:00 or 45:00.
prof.ask.lthr: Lactate threshold heart rate (bpm)? Your Garmin watch or a test shows it. Used only when there are no zones from the watch.
prof.zones.watch: Heart-rate zones — from your Garmin watch ({how}, workout of {date}):
prof.zones.lthr: Heart-rate zones — from threshold {lthr} in your profile (Friel):
prof.lthr_ignored: The threshold in your profile isn't used: zones come from the watch.
prof.zones.watch_run: Running heart-rate zones — from your Garmin watch ({how}, run of {date}):
rec.title: 🏅 Personal records
rec.none: No records yet: runs recorded with a Garmin watch are needed.
rec.footer: Best efforts within runs, from Garmin.
month.title: 🗓 {month} {year}
month.days: Days so far: {days}. Right column: the whole previous month.
cmp.pick: What to compare? Each period against the same stretch before it.
chart.volume.title: Weekly running volume
chart.volume.sub: {n} weeks · dashed — average {avg} km · grey — current week
chart.load.title: Training load
chart.load.sub: Acute (7 days) and chronic (average week over 28 days)
chart.hrv.title: Overnight HRV
chart.hrv.sub: {days} nights · band — your normal range from Garmin
chart.rhr.title: Resting heart rate
chart.eff.title: Running efficiency
chart.eff.sub: Metres per heartbeat: higher means faster at the same heart rate
filter.red_flag: ⚠️ This may be serious. Stop exercising. With chest pain or pressure, fainting, breathlessness at rest or a numb arm, call 112 (or your local emergency number) now. I'm not a doctor and can't judge this from watch data.
filter.hello: Hi! Ask about your training, sleep or recovery — or open /menu.
filter.off_topic: I help with training, recovery, sleep and nutrition. That one is outside what I do 🙂
filter.unsupported_language: I understand Russian and English. / Я понимаю русский и английский.
fast.metric.missing: No data for {date} yet — the watch hasn't synced, or wasn't worn that day.
fast.zones.title: Heart-rate zones
filter.injection: I'm Vita and only help with your training, sleep, recovery and nutrition — I don't change my rules 🙂 Ask me about those.
filter.too_long: That message is too long. Please ask in under 1000 characters — I'll answer more precisely.
filter.repeat: I already got this one — the answer is above 🙂
filter.rate_limited: The hourly limit of AI questions is used up. Commands in /menu work as usual; you can ask again in an hour.
fast.race.result: 🏁 Prediction for {target} km: {time} (pace {pace}/km) Riegel formula from your best {src} km in 12 months: {src_time} ({src_date}). An estimate, not a promise: over long distances volume and fuelling decide.
fast.race.no_data: A prediction needs your best running efforts from the last 12 months, and there are none yet.
